title: Corrections
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of the history and trends of the correctional system in the United States and describe the relationship between corrections and other components of the judicial system.
Analyze and describe the legal issues, specific laws, and general operations of correctional institutions.
Describe the differences between adult, juvenile, probation, and parole corrections systems.
Identify, understand, and demonstrate inmate processing procedures including receiving, discharge, and classification processes.
Identify the legal considerations of correctional systems and demonstrate knowledge of the rights of individuals within correctional systems.
Demonstrate professional best practices in methods of professional communications, interviewing and de-escalation techniques.
Identify, understand, and demonstrate appropriate and professional written communication skills.

missing_explained.why: not in the text; catalog lists only ENGL-C1000 with no honors alternative

notes: Catalog prints codes with hyphens (ADJ-20, ENGL-C1000); these were matched to the closed list's space-separated codes.
ADJ-8 (Juvenile Law and Procedures) and ADJ-25 (Introduction to Probation and Parole) are required in the catalog but absent from the closed list; recorded as catalog additions.
ENGL C1000H is on the closed list but the catalog section does not name it as an alternative to ENGL-C1000; reviewer may confirm whether the honors twin is accepted.
